description: Programmatically manage Meta ad campaigns, ad sets, creatives, custom audiences, and fetch performance insights at scale.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 access tokens (User, App, or System User access tokens) passed as bearer tokens or parameters.
credential_notes: Any developer can create a free Meta Developer account and app to obtain API credentials (app ID and secret) self-serve.
api_notes: Comprehensive coverage of Meta's advertising ecosystem including campaigns, ad accounts, targeting, reporting/insights, and creative assets.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Meta; community-driven or custom servers may exist.
rationale: While the API is fully public and credentials are self-serve and free, full production use and higher API rate limits or certain automated write actions require Meta App Review and business verification constraints.

evidence.note: Shows getting started steps and access token / authentication concepts for the Marketing API.
Overview page showing the public availability of the Marketing API for developers via Meta for Developers platform.
Details the broad API reference surface covering ads, ad sets, campaigns, insights, and custom audiences.
